## What this does

Reconciles the canonical specification to the *landed* design — the
P20.2/ADR-062 pattern applied to the landed Round-10 state — under
**ADR-145** (`docs/adr/ADR-145-round10-spec-reconciliation-to-landed-design.md`).
Six actual spec↔landed deviations were found and reconciled by `spec_src`
amendments (the generated spec itself is never hand-edited); everything else
audited is recorded as consistent or as a standing obligation:

| # | Site | Deviation → reconciliation | Authorising ADR |
|---|---|---|---|
| R10-A1 | §21.5 `SIG-INGEST-012` | "unavailable robots ⇒ refuse to run" → verdicts probed, classified per RFC 9309 §2.3.1.4 and recorded; a `disallowed`/`unretrievable` verdict does not gate — the fetch is stamped `robots_disregarded` (first-class provenance, never silent); the `ingestion_permitted` rights gate (HG-03) is untouched; challenges stay prohibited | ADR-088 (keeps ADR-087) |
| R10-A2 | §26 rule 2 `SIG-INGEST-036` | "honor robots.txt" → the same probe-and-record posture; the ADR-083 documented-API allow-list mode (previously only in the ADR register) is written into the policy text | ADR-088, ADR-083 |
| R10-A3 | §23.7 `SIG-INGEST-046b` | the upstream-specialist robots disallow is a **recorded** verdict rather than an enforced refusal; the affirmative rights reservation (`SIG-INGEST-046c`) and ask-first posture stand | ADR-088 |
| R10-A4 | §19.5 `SIG-GEO-012` | "generated by tippecanoe" → per-compartment archives (never merged); pinned tippecanoe **or** the deterministic pure-Python PMTiles v3 fallback | ADR-067, ADR-118 |
| R10-A5 | §37.2 `SIG-API-005` | "every read endpoint accepts `as_of_*`" → release-namespaced reads bind the as-of pair structurally; legacy selectors resolve via `sig.compat-index/1` or answer invalid/unavailable/ambiguous — never silently ignored | ADR-132, ADR-133, ADR-144 |
| R10-A6 | §55.1, §55.8 (`SIG-TRUST-009`, `SIG-TRUST-010`), §55.9 | the dated landed-status record: the S3 spine (HUMAN-H4 → P32.22a → HUMAN-H5 → P32.23) deferred wholesale by the operator's 2026-10-19 dispatch amendment; the candidate on `provisional-ruleset/1` with `evaluation.status=deferred`/`decision=null`/`applied=[]`/`mode=shadow`; evaluator shadow-only and never promoting; intake `operational=false` + `503 receiver_not_operating`; GATE-G3's signed reduced scope; ACCEPT-R10 signed 2026-09-28 — every deferred/gated row stays OPEN | ADR-142, ADR-144 |

**Checked and found consistent — no spec change:** `SIG-PUB-008` (the
obligation stands as the bar; the sole-maintainer posture is a recorded
operator waiver in `D-P21.4-2`/`PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md`, not spec text);
`SIG-INGEST-011/013/037`; `SIG-GEO-013`/`SIG-UI-038` (conditional obligations;
the no-basemap decision is already recorded); the remaining §55 ids
(capstone-verdicted — the PARTIAL/MISSING ones are obligations under
`D-R10-HUMAN-1`/`D-R6.1-EVAL`/P33.8, not text drift); the deferred and gated
live halves; the P32.10a/P33.1 recorded in-ticket repairs.
